newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: Australia won the toss and chose to bat against South Africa in the day-night fifth one-day international at the Wanderers on Tuesday.
South Africa - Adam Bacher, Herschelle Gibbs, Daryll Cullinan, Jacques Kallis, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Derek Crookes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Rudi Bryson, Allan Donald.
Australia - Michael DiVenuto, Greg Blewett, Stuart Law, Michael Bevan, Steve Waugh, Adam Gilchrist, Ian Healy (captain), Shane Warne, Adam Dale, Andrew Bichel, Jason Gillespie.
